description: Rust-native Minecraft world storage: content-addressed section dedup + zstd container. v0.9.55 THE WORST CASE: the -90% claim no longer rests on untouched chunks - the worst_case_probe stores ALL 262144 chunks through the normal pipeline (phase A pristine OFF, phase B pristine lifecycle fully colonized, 0 pristine remain), every stored chunk verified semantically (bad=0), export accounts 262144 stored + 0 pristine_skipped + 0 lost. v0.9.56 THE PACK SWEEP: the first CI run caught the probe's maintenance pass being too weak at bulk scale - one request_pack re-tiers ONE hot segment, and 262k chunks span ~4 x 64 MB segments, so the unswept container measured x0.2104 (863 B/chunk, -79%) and the x0.15 gate correctly refused it; the fix re-raises request_pack before every compact_step until no hot material remains (the JJThunder import pattern generalized to bulk scale), validated on a forced 12-segment run: 240 B/chunk (x0.0587) pure codec and 302 B/chunk (x0.0738) fully colonized - the shipped container converges to the same weight at every scale.
